summary: Red Cat Holdings filed an 8-K reporting the full exercise of the underwriters' option in a previously announced underwritten public offering. On May 14, 2026, underwriters exercised their option to purchase an additional 3,590,425 shares at the public offering price of $9.40 per share, bringing total shares sold to 27,526,596. The shares were sold under an automatic shelf registration statement on Form S-3ASR. Net proceeds will fund general corporate purposes and strategic growth initiatives, including potential acquisitions and R&D. This is a routine capital-raising transaction via an underwritten offering, not a special situation; the filing merely reports the completion of the greenshoe option exercise. No deal terms such as premium or close date are applicable.
